detail: Implementing variational quantum circuits and hybrid quantum-classical models for classification tasks and benchmarking them against classical baselines. Studying quantum data encoding techniques for mapping classical datasets into quantum feature spaces.

Developed a U-Net model for automated Meibomian gland segmentation from infrared meibography images. Built preprocessing and augmentation pipelines and evaluated segmentation using Dice Coefficient and IoU.

Twice selected as Team Lead for institute-level Smart India Hackathon internal rounds. Managed problem statement selection, architecture design, prototype development, and successfully cleared the internal qualifier to represent the college at the national level.
Certification covering Python for data science workflows — NumPy, Pandas, data visualization, statistical analysis, and ML model evaluation.
Hands-on workshop on predictive modeling, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques using Python.
Competitive algorithmic hackathon focusing on data structures, algorithms, and rapid problem solving under timed constraints.
